headline: As of 2026-11-04: 66,787,680 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+7.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 66,787,680 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+7.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (8,327,703), Texas (8,172,868), California (7,202,817).
